ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\angle AOC = 30^\circ$, $\angle BOC = 80^\circ$, and $OC$ bisects $\angle AOD$. What is the measure of $\angle BOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle AOC=30^\circ$ and OC bisects $\angle AOD$,\\
it follows that $\angle COD=\angle AOC=30^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle BOC=80^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle BOD=\angle BOC-\angle COD=\boxed{50^\circ}$.
